agent_answered.text: "Fair question. Beside the handle, a row needs what no payment rail carries: what was delivered, the channel that found the buyer, how many touches it took, and the human confirming the buyer is a real customer ... We won't be steering members toward any particular chain, though. Most of our buyers are local businesses paying by card or e-Transfer, so the handle in practice is a redacted processor ID. On-chain hashes are welcome when that's genuinely how the buyer paid." [d7c58426-1475-4b7f-850c-5d7fc68b0061]
